configurations.SEUIL_MONTANT_DEFAUT: Amount above which a fee claim requires the joint approval of the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director.
configurations.SEUIL_PROROGATIONS: Number of extensions beyond which an alert is raised.
configurations.CANAUX_NOTIFICATION_DEFAUT: Notification channels for internal users. In-app is always on; Outlook and Teams are optional.
configurations.CANAUX_NOTIFICATION_PRESTATAIRES: Notification channels for lawyers and other providers. None ticked: no provider is notified outside the application.
configurations.DELAI_VALIDATION_CONJOINTE: Maximum number of days for the joint approval of a fee claim.
configurations.DELAI_RAPPEL_CR_AVOCAT: Number of days after a past hearing before the lawyer is reminded that the hearing report is missing, then the pace of further reminders.
configurations.TAILLE_MAX_GED: Maximum size of a document uploaded to the document management system.
configurations.FORMATS_GED: File formats accepted by the document management system.
configurations.CHARGE_MAX_AVOCAT: Maximum number of active case files per counsel before an alert is raised.

metier.elements: {nombre, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}}
metier.fichierTropVolumineux: This file exceeds the maximum size of {taille}.
metier.formatNonAccepte: This format is not accepted. Allowed formats: {formats}.
metier.corrigezErreurs: Correct the highlighted fields before submitting.
metier.gardeSaisieMessage: Your entry has not been saved. Leaving this page will discard it.
metier.selectionnes: {nombre, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}

compte.description: What belongs to you alone in the application.
compte.signatureDescription: It is affixed to the instruction letters you sign, in place of a name to be signed by hand. You alone upload it: nobody else can post it for you, or retrieve it.
compte.signaturePortee: It adds no legal weight. What proves your signature is the timestamped record the application keeps, not this image.
compte.aucune: No signature uploaded. Letters you sign go out with your name, to be signed by hand.
compte.formatsAdmis: PNG or JPEG, 200 KB at most: these are the formats the letter can affix.
compte.formatRefuse: A signature is uploaded as PNG or JPEG.
compte.tropLourde: This image is over 200 KB: a scanned signature fits well below that.
compte.retraitMessage: Letters already signed do not change: they are produced and filed. The next ones will go out with your name, to be signed by hand.

clients.description: Search for a client and review all of their litigation case files.
clients.creerDescription: Client data is entered manually: no Core Banking integration is planned for version 1.
clients.modifierDescription: Correct the client’s name or contact details. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
clients.referenceFigee: The reference identifies the client: it cannot be changed.
clients.vueDescription: Every case file brought against this client, regardless of who it is assigned to.
clients.aucunDossierCategorie: No case file in this category.

agences.description: The bank’s branches. A case carries the code of its originating branch, and where applicable that of the branch handling the litigation: those codes are picked here, they are no longer typed in by hand.
agences.rechercherAide: By code or name, partial match: “bona” returns Bonanjo, Bonaberi, Bonamoussadi and Bonapriso.
agences.desactiverMessage: The {nom} branch ({code}) will no longer be offered when creating a case. Cases already citing it stay intact: it is closed, not deleted.
agences.codeAide: The code the bank uses, for instance 00002 for Bonanjo. It cannot be changed afterwards.
agences.codeFige: The code cannot be changed: cases carry it as plain text. A branch that changes code is a different branch - create it, then deactivate this one.
agences.villeAide: Required: two branches may share a name, and the city is what tells them apart during data entry.
agences.adresseAide: What separates two branches with the same name in the same city.
agences.aucuneAgenceTexte: The reference list is empty. Create a branch: without one, no case can be opened.
agences.aucuneAgenceRecherche: No branch matches this search. Try a shorter fragment of the code or name.

intervenants.description: External counsel and other providers. Counsel must exist here before they can be assigned to a case file.
intervenants.telephoneAide: Cameroon: nine-digit mobile, 6XX XXX XXX. Outside Cameroon: country code required, +33 X XX XX XX XX.
intervenants.telephoneFormat: Invalid number. Cameroon: nine digits starting with 6. Outside Cameroon: country code required (+33…).
intervenants.aucunIntervenantTexte: The directory is empty. Create counsel so that a case file can be opened.
intervenants.modifierDescription: Correct the name or contact details. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
intervenants.typeFige: The type cannot be changed: a counsel does not become another provider.
intervenants.compteFige: The login is managed in Keycloak, which creates and authenticates accounts: it cannot be changed here.
intervenants.compteObligatoire: The username counsel signs in with, for example avocat.dupont. It is required to submit fee claims and filings.
intervenants.comptePrestataire: Other providers have no account: they are notified by email.
intervenants.notificationAide: SMS, WhatsApp and personal email, to the contact details on this record. The channels actually used are set by the Legal Department.

dossiers.description: Search a litigation case or open a new one.
dossiers.creerDescription: The category follows from the nature you choose: it determines the required documents.
dossiers.aideNature: The case category follows from it: it decides which documents are required.
dossiers.aidePiecesRecouvrement: A recovery case requires the original credit file and the transfer record. The references naming them are optional.
dossiers.aidePiecesLitiges: An operational dispute requires the account incident and the supporting evidence. The references naming them are optional.
dossiers.aideAffectation: At least one lawyer and at least one counsel are mandatory.
dossiers.aideSensibilite: The threshold and client type are a proposal, subject to approval by the Legal Director or Deputy.
dossiers.renvoiAlarmes: Follow-up alarms are set from the case file, under “Alarms”: they carry a due date and notify their author on the day.

fiche.nonSensible: This case does not require special attention.
fiche.diligenceProposerDescription: The case will await arbitration. Nothing changes for fee requests until the Head or Deputy Head decides.
fiche.diligencePoserTitre: Set the case to special attention
fiche.diligencePoserDescription: Special attention applies at once, with no arbitration: you are the decision. A pending proposal on this case will be settled at the threshold you give.
fiche.diligenceRetirerDescription: The case becomes ordinary again and its threshold returns to the global one. Nothing is deleted and its history stays whole.
fiche.diligenceMotif: What has changed since the case was opened
fiche.diligenceMotifFacultatif: Optional: the decision is yours. Filling it in helps whoever reads the case again in six months.
fiche.aucuneTransition: No transition available from this status on this screen.
fiche.aideEnDelibere: The stage is under deliberation: postponement, reopening and the decision are handled in the Deliberations tab.
fiche.confirmerRecoursMessage: Moving “{etape}” back to in progress means an appeal is lodged: the next stage will be opened automatically.
fiche.positionnerTitre: Position the case at a stage
fiche.positionnerAide: For a case that arrives already advanced in the procedure.
fiche.confirmerPositionnementMessage: Positioning the case at “{etape}” will also create: {intermediaires}, with status Opening.
fiche.lectureSeuleEtapes: Only a lawyer can move stages forward.
fiche.documentsVideTexte: No document has been filed for this case yet.
fiche.affectationDescription: These lists replace the current assignment: anything you deselect is removed.
fiche.doublonMessage: At least one selected person is already assigned to this case. If you confirm, the assignment is saved and the Legal Director is alerted.
fiche.derogationDescription: The request is submitted to the Legal Director or Deputy for decision.
fiche.sensibiliteDescription: The proposed threshold and type may be adjusted when approving.
fiche.arbitrageDescription: Approving applies the requested threshold to the case; rejecting keeps the current one.

documents.piecesAide: Optional: these documents can also be added later from the case page.
documents.fichiersAide: Each expected item must carry its file: the document is what counts, not the reference naming it.
documents.apercuImpossible: No preview for this format: download the file to open it.
documents.apercuErreur: The document could not be loaded.
documents.depotEchec: The case was created, but {nombre, plural, one {# document could not be uploaded} other {# documents could not be uploaded}}: {noms}. Add {nombre, plural, one {it} other {them}} from the Documents tab.
documents.suppressionMessage: The document “{nom}” will be permanently deleted.
documents.demandeSuppressionMessage: The document “{nom}” will remain visible until the Legal Director or Deputy decides.
documents.demandeEnvoyee: Deletion request sent to the Legal Director and Deputy.
documents.telechargerSansEnteteAide: Print-ready copy for the bank preprinted paper: content only, without logo or legal notices.
documents.fichierManquant: This item is required: attach its file.
documents.piecesManquantes: Required items are missing: the case was not created.
documents.apercuWordAncien: This file uses the legacy Word format (.doc), which the browser cannot display. Download it to open it, or save it as .docx from Word.
documents.apercuWordErreur: This Word document could not be displayed. Download it to open it.

suppressions.description: Lawyers do not delete their own documents: their requests wait here for your decision, with a reminder every 72 hours. Open the document before deciding.
suppressions.approbationMessage: The document “{nom}” will be permanently deleted, and the lawyer notified.
suppressions.rejetDescription: The document “{nom}” will be kept; the lawyer will receive your reason.
suppressions.rejetee: Request rejected: the lawyer has been notified.

rapportJournalier.description: One day of document activity: case files handled, documents added, new cases and hearings scheduled.
rapportJournalier.videTexte: No case file handled, no document added, no new case and no hearing scheduled.

decisions.aucuneArchivee: No judgment archived on this case file.
decisions.sansEtapeCloturee: An adjudication follows the exhaustion of appeals: no stage of this case file is closed yet.
decisions.adjudicationAide: An adjudication follows a final judgment in the Bank’s favour, on a closed stage.
decisions.condamnationAide: Tracking starts “Pending”; update its status as enforcement progresses.

jurisprudence.description: Judgments archived and indexed by in-house lawyers: extracts, certified copies and enforceable copies. Search matches part of a word, regardless of case.
jurisprudence.videTexte: A judgment is archived from its case file, or from this page if it has none.
jurisprudence.archiverDescription: Upload the judgment as a PDF (10 MB at most) and index it: keywords, nature, court and date.
jurisprudence.fichierObligatoire: Upload the judgment as a PDF.
jurisprudence.motsClesAide: Separated by commas, for example: foreclosure, mortgage.
jurisprudence.archivee: Judgment archived in the case-law database.

publications.description: Hearing reports and documents submitted by counsel. The Executive Assistant approves them before in-house lawyers can read them.
publications.videTexte: Filings will appear here as soon as counsel submit them.
publications.ongletAucune: No filing on this case file.
publications.accesRestreintTexte: Counsel restricted this filing to another in-house lawyer.
publications.introuvableTexte: It does not exist, or has not yet been approved by the Executive Assistant.
publications.validerMessage: The in-house lawyers on the case file will be able to read it, and will be notified.
publications.validerMessageRestreinte: Only {nom}, the recipient chosen by counsel, will be able to read it, and will be notified.
publications.validee: Filing approved: the in-house lawyers have been notified.
publications.rejetDescription: It will not be readable; counsel will receive your reason.
publications.rejetee: Filing rejected: counsel has been notified.
publications.commenterAide: It goes to the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director, never directly to counsel.
publications.commentaireEnvoye: Comment sent to the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director.
publications.correspondanceAide: A single letter per filing, on behalf of the Bank: it gathers the in-house lawyers’ comments.
publications.transmettreMessage: It will be sent to counsel and can no longer be edited or supplemented.
publications.accuserReceptionTitre: Acknowledge receipt of the hearing report?
publications.accuserReceptionMessage: The hearing report is already visible to the legal department. Acknowledging receipt only records that you have received it.

constitutions.description: Appointing counsel or another provider commits the Bank: it requires the second signature of the line manager, which generates the letter of appointment.
constitutions.signerMessageAvocat: The letter of appointment of {prestataire} will be generated and filed in the documents of case {dossier}; counsel will be notified.
constitutions.signerMessageAutre: The letter of appointment of {prestataire} will be generated and filed in the documents of case {dossier}. This provider has no account: send them the letter.
constitutions.signee: Appointment signed: the letter is in the case file’s documents.
constitutions.rejetDescription: The request will go back to the in-house lawyer with your reason; no letter will be generated.
constitutions.rejetee: Request rejected: the in-house lawyer has been notified.
constitutions.solliciterDescription: The request will be submitted to the line manager for a second signature.
constitutions.sollicitee: Request sent to the line manager for signature.
constitutions.aucunPrestataire: No provider in the directory: the Legal Director or the Deputy must create one first.
constitutions.lettreDescription: Complete the letter before submitting it for signature. Anything left blank prints as dotted lines, as on paper.
constitutions.lettreLectureSeule: This letter has been signed and filed: it can no longer be changed. A correction requires a new request.
constitutions.lettreNumeroALaSignature: The number is assigned on signature. You may impose one.
constitutions.lettreNumeroAttribue: Number assigned when this letter was signed.
constitutions.lettreCorpsAide: Dotted lines mark what remains to be filled in: leave them if the value will be written by hand.

repertoire.description: Partner counsel, from the least to the most loaded: the useful order to choose who takes a case.
repertoire.charge: {nombre, plural, =0 {No active case} one {# active case} other {# active cases}}
repertoire.performanceAide: Performance: share of favourable deliberations on counsel’s cases; 0% until a deliberation is delivered.

frais.description: Each fee request goes through a compliance check (Executive Assistant), then a merit review (Deputy Legal Director). A case requiring special attention, or an amount above the threshold, also requires the joint approval of the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director. An approved request is then marked as paid.
frais.videTexte: Requests will appear here as soon as they reach this stage.
frais.piecesAide: Documents declared by the lawyer on submission.
frais.conjointeOui: Joint approval by the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director required
frais.conjointeNon: The Deputy Legal Director approves alone
frais.motifSeuil: the amount exceeds the applicable threshold of {seuil}.
frais.sousSeuil: case without special attention, amount under the applicable threshold of {seuil}.
frais.aucuneAction: No action is yours at this stage.
frais.transmettreMessage: The documents are compliant and the invoice has never been presented: the request moves to the Deputy Legal Director.
frais.transmise: Request forwarded to the Deputy Legal Director.
frais.validerMessage: The request will be approved; the Executive Assistant can then mark it as paid.
frais.validerMessageConjointe: This case requires joint approval: the request will move to the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director, who will be notified.
frais.conjointeDeclenchee: Joint approval triggered: the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director have been notified.
frais.accordMessage: Both approvals, from the Legal Director and the Deputy Legal Director, are needed to approve the request.
frais.accordEnregistreValidee: Approval recorded: both approvals are in, the request is approved.
frais.attenteDj: Your approval is recorded. The request still awaits the Legal Director’s.
frais.attenteDja: Your approval is recorded. The request still awaits the Deputy Legal Director’s.
frais.rejetDescription: The request will be closed; the lawyer will receive your reason.
frais.rejetee: Request rejected: the lawyer has been notified.
frais.payerMessage: Only once the payment has been confirmed through the Bank’s channels. The lawyer and the Legal Department will be notified.
frais.payee: Payment recorded: the lawyer and the Legal Department have been notified.

audiences.planifierDescription: The hearing must belong to a stage in progress and be dated in the future.
audiences.aucuneEtapeEnCours: No stage is in progress: move a stage to “In progress” from the Stages tab first.
audiences.doublonMessage: A hearing is already scheduled for this stage on this date. If you confirm, it is saved and the Legal Director is alerted.
audiences.compteRenduDescription: Accepted from the day of the hearing.
audiences.creerAlarmeDescription: The alarm fires at its deadline.
audiences.reprogrammerDescription: The current alarm is closed and replaced by a new one with the new deadline.
audiences.champObjetFacultatif: Subject - optional, the current one is kept
audiences.annulationDescription: The hearing leaves the calendar and its exports, and its reminders are no longer sent. For an adjournment, then schedule the new date.
audiences.traiterMessage: The alarm “{objet}” is closed without being replaced. To push it back, reschedule it instead.
audiences.dateAvantOuverture: This date precedes the case opening.
audiences.champJuridictionAide: Where the hearing will be held. The case court by default; change it for an appeal.

deliberes.mettreEnDelibereDescription: The court has reserved judgment: record the date on which it announces it will deliver its decision.
deliberes.aucuneEtapeEnDelibere: No stage is under deliberation: first move a stage to “Under deliberation” from the Stages tab.
deliberes.dejaRendu: The decision has already been delivered
deliberes.aideEcheance: Required for an unfavourable or mixed outcome: the last day to lodge an appeal.
deliberes.prorogerDescription: “Judgment postponed to …”: the new date replaces the announced date. Earlier postponements stay in the history.
deliberes.seuilDepasse: Judgment postponed to {date} - {n} postponements: above the threshold, the Legal Director and Deputy Director have been alerted.
deliberes.rabattreDescription: The judge reopens the proceedings before ruling: the stage returns to “In progress”, new hearings can be scheduled, and judgment can be reserved again.
deliberes.delibereRabattu: Proceedings reopened: the stage is “In progress” again.
deliberes.viderAria: Record the decision for the judgment announced for {date}
deliberes.viderDescription: The court has delivered its decision: the stage moves to “Judgment delivered”.
deliberes.recoursExerce: Appeal lodged: the next stage is open.
deliberes.recoursOuvert: To lodge an appeal, move the stage to “In progress” from the Stages tab: the next stage will open.
deliberes.aucunRecours: Favourable decision: no appeal available. The stage can be closed from the Stages tab.

calendrier.description: All hearings in the period, across all cases.
calendrier.nombre: {nombre, plural, =0 {No hearing} one {# hearing} other {# hearings}}

notifications.description: Alerts addressed to you. They remain available even if the live connection drops.
notifications.badgeCompteur: {nombre, plural, =0 {no unread notification} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}
notifications.tempsReelInterrompu: Live updates interrupted - refreshing every 30 seconds
notifications.videTexte: Alerts raised by your case files will appear here, without reloading.

supervisionAlertes.description: The in-app channel is the mandatory channel for alerts. This measure says whether it did its job over the chosen period.
supervisionAlertes.fenetreInversee: The start date is later than the end date.
supervisionAlertes.aucuneMesure: No alert was raised over this period. There is nothing to measure, which is neither compliant nor at fault.
supervisionAlertes.tauxDelivranceAide: Share of alerts the channel delivered, either immediately or waiting in the notification list. Only diffusion failures count against the system.
supervisionAlertes.tauxTempsReelAide: Share of alerts delivered to someone connected at the time. A low figure describes usage, not an outage.
supervisionAlertes.nonTraitees: {nombre} alert(s) from this period have not yet been opened by their recipient. This count feeds no rate: it says something other than delivery.

supervisionNotifications.description: What each channel produced over the period: queued, handed to the engine, confirmed by it, abandoned. “Handed over” does not mean “received”: only a confirmation proves that.
supervisionNotifications.moteurCoupe: The Notification Engine is disabled on the server: notifications are prepared and logged, but nothing is sent.
supervisionNotifications.suiviIndisponible: The engine does not publish delivery receipts: a notification handed over cannot be confirmed here. “Handed over” is therefore the last known state of a successful send, and the “Confirmed” column stays empty without signalling a problem.
supervisionNotifications.fenetreInversee: The end date must follow the start date.
supervisionNotifications.aucunEchecTexte: Over this period, no delivery failed, went unanswered, or lacked a recipient.

configurations.description: The settings driving the thresholds, deadlines, checks and notifications of the application. A change takes effect immediately.
configurations.lectureSeule: Read only - only the Legal Director and Deputy Director may change these settings.

refus.entier: A whole number is expected, with no space or separator.
refus.bornes: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
refus.inconnue: This value is not one of the accepted values.
refus.vide: The list contains an empty item.

configurations.videTexte: System settings are created when the application is installed.

grilleNotifications.description: For each channel, the events sent through it. A disabled channel keeps its column: it applies as soon as the channel is turned back on. Nothing is sent until the Notification Engine is enabled on the server.

tableauDeBord.description: Legal Department indicators, across all case files, continuously refreshed.
tableauDeBord.nbDossiersActifsAide: Case files with at least one ongoing stage.
tableauDeBord.nbAffairesVideesAide: Cases with no stage still under way. Together with active cases, they make up every case opened.
tableauDeBord.nbDemandesFraisEnAttenteAide: Claims in the approval circuit, neither paid nor rejected.
tableauDeBord.nbProrogationsAlerteAide: Deliberations past the extension threshold, not yet handled.
tableauDeBord.nbLitigesGagnesAide: Favourable rulings on recovery cases, across all periods.
tableauDeBord.nbLitigesPerdusAide: Unfavourable rulings. Not the remainder of those won: mixed decisions are counted separately.
tableauDeBord.nbLitigesMixtesAide: Neither won nor lost. Counting them apart avoids assigning them to either side by default.
tableauDeBord.provisionsReprisesAide: Total released on recorded auction sales.

rapports.description: Compile the Legal Department's activity over a period, to read or to export.
rapports.typeAide: Sets the suggested range; you remain free to adjust it.
rapports.periodeInversee: The end date must follow the start date.
rapports.videTexte: Widen the dates or pick another period: no case file, hearing, fee claim or deliberation falls within it.
rapports.exportVide: Nothing to export: the period has no activity.
rapports.avantGeneration: Pick a period, then show the report.

portail.espaceDescription: Your submissions and the instruction letters appointing you.
portail.videPublicationsTexte: Your hearing reports and documents will appear here, with their status and, if rejected, the reason to address.
portail.videConstitutionsTexte: The Legal Department appoints you case file by case file; signed letters will appear here.
portail.dossierAide: Among the case files you are assigned to.
portail.aucunDossier: You are not assigned to any case file yet. Once the Legal Department entrusts you with one, you will be able to file claims and hearing reports.
portail.fraisDescription: Your claim goes to the compliance check, then to the merits review.
portail.referenceFactureAide: It must be unique: an invoice already filed is rejected.
portail.piecesAide: Upload each supporting document (PDF, image or Word document). They are submitted with your claim and can be opened by the Assistant during the compliance check.
portail.publicationDescription: A hearing report recounts a hearing, with a supporting document if needed. A case file document is transmitted on its own.
portail.aucuneAudience: No hearing is scheduled on this case file yet.
portail.publicationDeposee: Publication submitted. It will be visible once approved.
portail.compteRenduDepose: Hearing report submitted. It is immediately visible to the legal department; the assistant will acknowledge receipt.
portail.natureDepot: What would you like to submit?

compteRendu.aide: Recount what happened at a hearing on your case file. You may attach the court record or a note.

document.aide: Transmit a document, ruling or pleading, with no hearing report.

portail.pieceJointeAide: The document supporting your report: court record, hearing note. The report stands without it.
portail.compteNonRattacheTitre: Your account is not linked to the directory yet
portail.compteNonRattacheTexte: A lawyer must be registered in the directory by the Legal Department, with their login identifier, before using the portal. This is not a mistake on your side: contact the Legal Department so they can complete your registration.

audit.description: Who did what, and when. Filter by person, period or kind of action, or follow the history of one case file.
audit.perimetreCouvert: The audit records changes. Views are not traced, except those of this screen: the absence of a line does not prove the absence of an action.
audit.consultationTracee: Your use of this screen is itself recorded, along with the criteria you applied.
audit.dossierManquant: Enter the number of the case file to consult.
audit.fenetreInversee: The start date is later than the end date.
audit.exportDescription: Every export is sealed: the file is archived and its fingerprint recorded, so it can later be shown that the document produced is the one that was sealed.
audit.periodeObligatoire: Choose a period: an archive must state what it covers.
audit.archivesVide: No export has been produced yet.
audit.verifierDescription: Drop an audit document you received: its fingerprint is computed on your machine - the file never leaves it - and compared with the archives produced here.
audit.verifierReconnue: File recognised: archive {reference}, from {debut} to {fin}, {lignes} row(s).
audit.verifierPortee: The file has not changed since it was sealed. This does not establish anteriority against a third party, as the application holds both the file and the record.
audit.verifierInconnueAide: The document has been altered, or it does not come from this application. Share this fingerprint to investigate.
audit.verifierEchec: Verification failed. Try again with the original file.
